title: Agent syscall envelope
description: Semantic-capability envelope predicted from an LLM prompt + MCP tool schemas. Compiled into per-syscall checks at enforcement time.

rationale.description: One-sentence explanation of what the agent is expected to do to satisfy the prompt, in the envelope's terms.

read_paths.description: Glob patterns for paths the agent may READ. Support: absolute paths, `**` (recursive wildcard), `*` (single segment).

write_paths.description: Glob patterns for paths the agent may WRITE / CREATE.

delete_paths.description: Glob patterns for paths the agent may DELETE (unlink).

allow_egress.description: May the agent make any outbound network connect() at all?

allow_hosts.description: Hostnames, IPs, or CIDRs the agent may connect() to. Reserved for future use — current L3 sensor does not carry destination address in connect() events.

allow_ports.description: Destination TCP/UDP ports the agent may connect() to. Reserved as above.

allow_spawn.description: May the agent execve() any child process at all?

allow_binaries.description: Absolute paths or basenames of binaries the agent may execve(). E.g. `/usr/bin/git` or `git`.
